name: Astoria: Lost Kisses
source: Astoria: Lost Kisses is a spin-off of the popular Lovestruck Series, Astoria: Fate’s Kiss originally launched in July of 2015. In this spin-off, users will once again get to experience the magic of romancing gods and monsters from Greek Mythology living in modern day New York City. Astoria: Lost Kisses takes place in the year between Seasons 1 and 2 of Astoria: Fate’s Kiss and will let users experience a familiar, but exciting story with their favorite love interests!
translation: 《阿斯托利亚：遗失之吻》是热门《心动不已》系列的外传；《阿斯托利亚：命运之吻》最初于2015年7月推出。在这部外传中，玩家将再次体验与生活在现代纽约市的希腊神话诸神和怪物谈恋爱的魔力。《阿斯托利亚：遗失之吻》的故事发生在《阿斯托利亚：命运之吻》第一季与第二季之间，让玩家与喜爱的恋爱对象一起经历熟悉却刺激的故事。
